_comment: DataSF Street Tree Inventory (tkzw-k3nq) species -> visual class (P4.5), by the botanical name before ' :: ', first matching regex wins. Classes: 0 plane (broad deciduous crowns), 1 ficus (dense rounded evergreen crowns), 2 palm, 3 broadleaf (elm-like), 4 conifer, 5 broadleaf-fine (feathery or small-leaved crowns, drawn with the locust builder). Unknown or unnamed trees are broadleaf. Records that are not standing trees are dropped. Visual grouping chosen for this game, not a botanical classification.
